title: Semrush Domain Overview Scraper
description: Get Semrush-style domain metrics for keywords, visits, traffic value, authority, backlinks, and referring domains. Batch websites to benchmark search visibility or assess competitors.

batch.title: Domains
batch.description: Domains for which to retrieve an overview.
batch.valueDescription: domain used to run this search.

schema.description: Root domain or subdomain to analyze

storeCopy.seoDescription: Collect Semrush metrics for organic keywords, traffic, authority, and backlinks. Benchmark domains and enrich competitor research with visibility data.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve a domain overview with organic search metrics, backlink counts, traffic estimates, and available engagement history. Submit multiple domains in one run.
useCases: SEO consultants can benchmark traffic, keywords, authority, and backlinks.
Marketing teams can compare traffic and engagement trends for target websites.
Sales teams can enrich company research with organic visibility metrics.
howToUse: Add one root domain or subdomain to `domains` for each overview.
Set `maxResults` to cap saved domain records.
Read overview metrics and website engagement fields.

faqs.question: Can the overview contain missing metrics?
faqs.answer: Yes. Coverage varies by domain and region. Check `covered` and `coverage` before comparing metrics.

fields.name: search_parameters
fields.description: Domain and market database selected for this Semrush overview.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Website domain summarized by the overview.

fields.name: covered
fields.description: True when Semrush returned coverage for this domain and market.

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Availability indicators for domain, backlink, and traffic metrics.

fields.name: semrush_rank
fields.description: Semrush global rank reported for the domain.

fields.name: organic_keywords
fields.description: Estimated number of keywords bringing organic search visits.

fields.name: organic_traffic
fields.description: Estimated monthly visits from organic search.

fields.name: organic_traffic_cost
fields.description: Estimated monthly value of the organic search traffic.

fields.name: authority_score
fields.description: Semrush Authority Score for the analyzed domain.

fields.name: backlinks_count
fields.description: Total backlinks reported for the domain.

fields.name: referring_domains_count
fields.description: Number of unique domains linking to the website.

fields.name: website
fields.description: Website details such as country, visits, engagement, and traffic history.

fields.name: input_domain
fields.description: Website domain submitted for the overview lookup.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this domain overview was collected.
